content: चाटुः, -टु {%n.%} .²1 [चट्-उण्] Pleasing or agreeable words, sweet or coaxing speech, flattery (especially of a lover to his sweet-heart); प्रियः प्रियायाः प्रकरोति चाटुम् <ls>Ṛs. 6. 14</ls>; विरचितचाटुवचनरचनं चरणरचितप्रणिपातम् <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 83</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 175</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 3. 14</ls>; <ls>Ch. P. 20</ls>; (the greater part of the 10th canto of गीतगोविन्द consists of such coaxing) .²2 Distinct or clear speech. .²3 Endearing words or acts; <ls>Māl. 10. 1</ls>.
